name: midday-viaduct-person-start
midday-viaduct-person-1-at
js: (() => { const a = window.__CITY_APP, C = window.CITY, e = a.controllerManager.getActiveEntity(), p = e.position; return { mode: a.controllerManager.activeMode, x: +p.x.toFixed(1), y: +p.y.toFixed(2), z: +p.z.toFixed(1), water: !!C.waterAt(p.x, p.z), roadBridge: !!(C.bridgeAt && C.bridgeAt(p.x, p.z)), bridgeSidewalk: !!(C.bridgeSidewalkAt && C.bridgeSidewalkAt(p.x, p.z)), curbIsland: !!C.blockAt(p.x, p.z), deck: C.SUBWAY_VIADUCTS[0].deck, motorwayDeck: !!C.motorwayDeckAt(p.x, p.z, p.y, 0.6) }; })()
